title: Obxialabs
tagline: A DeFi-based AI agent for business automation, helping companies streamline marketing, boost productivity, and optimize operations effortlessly.
description:
ObxiaLabs is revolutionizing Web3 business automation with AI-driven solutions. Our latest tool enhances productivity by automating Instagram DMs, providing instant, intelligent replies to engage your audience effortlessly. No more missed messages—just seamless communication, 24/7.
Boost your efficiency, scale your outreach, and let AI handle the conversations while you focus on growth. Welcome to the future of Web3 automation with ObxiaLabs! 🚀
how_its_made:
This project is a combination of modern web, blockchain, and AI technologies, each playing a crucial role in shaping its functionality.

Frontend: I used Next.js for its server-side rendering, static generation, and API route capabilities, which helped optimize performance. The component-based architecture made the UI modular and reusable.
Styling: Tailwind CSS allowed for rapid styling with utility classes, eliminating the need to write custom CSS from scratch while keeping the design highly flexible.
Blockchain Integration: The project is built on Base, a Layer 2 blockchain by Coinbase, which ensures fast and cost-efficient transactions. I leveraged smart contracts to handle key blockchain functionalities.
AI Integration: I utilized AgentKit by Coinbase to power AI-driven automation and decision-making processes. This added an intelligent layer to the project, enhancing user experience and functionality.
